entities.summary: Rubén Darío Tejada Abrego is a Panamanian professional baseball shortstop who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the New York Mets, St. Louis Cardinals, San Francisco Giants, and Baltimore Orioles.
